Q: Azure Durable Functions Fan-out/Fan-in with Durable Timers A:

In order to run the activities in parallel, you'll need to run context.call_activity for all of them first. Also, you should run a timer for each of them. I'm not familiar enough with Python to give concrete code, but you would then need to do a wait any for all of the tasks created earlier. Then you need to figure out which one completed. So you'll need to store the tasks in a data structure that allows you to figure that func3's timeout task completed (i.e. func3 timed out). Then you check if all activities have either timed out or completed, and if not, you run wait any again with the tasks of the remaining activities. It is possible for an activity to then complete that already timed out, you can choose what to do with that information in your code.

Q: Should I learn Java first before learning Spring Boot, or start building directly? (0 Java experience) A:

It would be difficult to learn spring boot when you don't know syntax of java programming language and programming concepts in general. Since spring boot is a java framework built on top of java programming language I would definitely recommend to learn java programming language first.

Q: How to change UI display / change code from home assistant A:

Yep, a lot of people do that.

If you're just looking to change how things look, you can edit your dashboard directly in Home Assistant, use custom cards, or install themes through HACS.

If you want to edit YAML files or work on custom integrations, you can install the VS Code Server add-on. It basically gives you a VS Code environment right inside Home Assistant, which is much more convenient than editing files manually.

Q: How is ai-model different to rag-model A:

AI Model: Generates answers from what it learned during training.

RAG Model: Searches relevant documents/data first, then generates an answer using that information.

Simple example:

  • AI Model = Memory

  • RAG Model = Memory + Search

RAG is usually better when you need up-to-date or company-specific information.
